name: RAdam
description: Rectified Adam optimizer. foreach, fused, and capturable modes are not claimed; DDP/FSDP/ZeRO compatibility matches a plain torch optimizer step on local parameters.

examples.title: Optimize parameters with RAdam
examples.code:
import torch
from topologies.implementations.optimizers.radam import radam

parameter = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(2.0))
optimizer = radam([parameter], lr=0.05)
optimizer.zero_grad()
parameter.square().backward()
optimizer.step()
